summary: 10.0.35.07 Comprehensive Desktop Parity & Enterprise Hardening Release - Full 10-Defect Resolution: Sale Import stock fallback, Purchase Import preflight reference checks, Bank Statement ISO date normalization, ERP server error transparency, universal direct PDF file downloads (no window.print), Customer/Supplier 360 segmented tabs & attachments API, Purchase Recon reference/date/link parity, Bank Statement history Actions dropdown & row highlight, Bank Entry table alignment & expense category dropdown, Stock Register KPI card icons & uniform 84px height.
highlights: 1. Data Import Sale Import: Computed stock fallback to openingStock/currentStock when availableStock is undefined, preventing false 'insufficient stock' validation errors.
2. Data Import Purchase Import: Added strict preflight validation against REF_ITEM (ITMXXX) and REF_SUPPLIER formats; flags invalid item codes into Review instead of crashing on execution.
3. Data Import Bank Statement: Normalized transaction and value dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD and timestamps to YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, resolving statement batch import failures.
4. ERP Server Error Transparency: Extracted errData.details and errData.errors in ApiService, displaying clear, actionable messages instead of generic server error dialogs.

5. Universal PDF Generation: Replaced browser window.print() across Sales, Purchase, Finance, and Reports with direct .pdf downloads using FormatUtil.downloadTablePdf and ApiService.downloadDocumentPdf.

6. Customer & Supplier 360: Upgraded tab navigation to segmented pill tab strips matching Reporting Dashboard; resolved 401 token issue and routed attachments to /api/support/documents/{type}/{id}/attachments.

7. Purchase Recon Register: Bound canonical reference, formatted dates with company format, rendered linked chips from bankLinks with click navigation & row highlight, bound s.reconCount, and styled btn-purple.
8. Bank Statement History: Replaced separate buttons with purple Actions ▼ dropdown menu; wired search filter and highlightRowInTable when navigating to Bank Entry or Expense Entry.
9. Bank Entry Table Alignment & Operating Expense Dropdown: Unhid th-bank-mode for exact 9-column alignment; queried EXPENSE_CATEGORY first to populate Operating Expense Head dropdown.
10. Stock Register KPI Cards: Added colorful icons and standard-kpi-body wrappers with uniform 84px height matching Reporting Dashboard.
